summary: Fills a 4x4 matrix at a1 with a rotation built from the angle a2, returning a1. Element 0 (byte offset 0x0) is set to 1.0 and element 15 (byte offset 0x3C) to 1.0; a 2x2 rotation block is placed at elements (1,1), (1,2), (2,1), (2,2) (byte offsets 0x14, 0x18, 0x24, 0x28) using cos(a2) and sin(a2), with -sin(a2) at the (2,1) element; every other element is zeroed. Under a standard row-major layout this pattern places the rotation block on the middle rows/columns, which corresponds to rotation about the first (X) axis rather than the Y axis the canonical and legacy ABI names suggest; the axis labeling cannot be resolved from this packet alone.

local_names.a2: rotation angle in radians consumed by cos and sin
local_names.v4: sin(a2), stored to element 6 (byte offset 0x18) and negated to element 9 (byte offset 0x24)

operations.description: Evaluate v3 = cos(a2) and v4 = sin(a2) before filling the matrix.
Matrix row 0: store 1.0 at byte offset 0x0 and zero floats at byte offsets 0x4, 0x8, 0xC.
Matrix row 1: store 0.0 at byte offset 0x10, cos(a2) at byte offset 0x14, sin(a2) at byte offset 0x18, and 0.0 at byte offset 0x1C.
Matrix row 2: store 0.0 at byte offset 0x20, -sin(a2) at byte offset 0x24, cos(a2) at byte offset 0x28, and 0.0 at byte offset 0x2C.
Matrix row 3: store 0.0 at byte offsets 0x30, 0x34, 0x38 and 1.0 at byte offset 0x3C (homogeneous element).
Return the original a1 pointer unchanged.
